outcome: prevalence of anatomic pelvic organ prolapse (POP)
finding: While there were changes in pelvic organ support during pregnancy and after both vaginal and cesarean deliveries, the prevalence of anatomic POP was low, and the ability to recover by 12 months postpartum was good.
mod_finding: Postpartum changes in pelvic organ support were present following both vaginal and cesarean deliveries, but were more pronounced following vaginal delivery.
